hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in *migrations/*.sql|*/.env|*/uv.lock|*/poetry.lock) echo "Protected file — edit requires explicit user approval: $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" >&2; exit 1;; esac
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *.py ]]; then python -m ruff format "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; python -m ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == */frontend/*.ts* || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == */frontend/*.js* ]]; then cd frontend && npm run lint --silent 2>/dev/null || true; fi
